Attached is our initial SIG prefill (redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx). Please treat this as a living document — Monica will own evidence uploads.

A few clarifying questions that will help us complete the prefill accurately: 
- PHI scope: Can you list the categories of PHI expected in pilot (structured claims, clinical notes, images, etc.)?
- BAA: Do you require a BAA before we start the pilot, or would a BAA be signed ahead of production rollout?
- Retention: What retention period do you expect for processed outputs and logs (30/90/365 days)?
- Endpoints: Which environment will we integrate with (staging vs production)? Hostnames or IP allowlist will help our ops team.
- Volume: Rough estimate of tokens/day or requests/hour so we size the pilot properly.
- Evidence contacts: Who on your security team can receive SOC2 artifacts / control mappings?

I flagged two follow-ups for internal owners: Karthik — data residency and deployment model; Monica — evidence collection / SOC2 artifact distillation.
